items.text: Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, a 2% increase year-over-year.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year, the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year.

items.text: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.
items.quote: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.

items.text: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million the prior year.
items.quote: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million from the prior year.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: The recruited advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets, according to CEO Paul Shoukry on the fiscal fourth quarter earnings call.
items.quote: Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets, said CEO Paul Shoukry, on the firm’s fiscal fourth quarter earnings call.
items.scope: recruited advisors in domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors had earned Raymond James's Private Wealth Advisor designation, which the firm describes as a key recruitment and retention signal.
items.quote: As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation, according to Raymond James. The program has been a key recruitment and retention signal for the firm as it competes for advisors who build practices around affluent households.

items.text: Raymond James recently posted record quarterly client assets and strong recruiting gains across its advisor channels, with CEO Paul Shoukry crediting flexibility in affiliation options.
items.quote: The firm recently posted record quarterly client assets and strong recruiting gains across its advisor channels, with CEO Paul Shoukry crediting flexibility in affiliation options for the growth.

items.text: Raymond James recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division; the team managed about $700 million in client assets and joined Pinnacle Financial Partners' investment program from Truist Investment Services.
items.quote: Raymond James has recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division, the unit dedicated to bank and credit union advisors. The team, which manages about $700 million in client assets, joins the investment program of Pinnacle Financial Partners from Truist Investment Services.

items.text: Raymond James & Associates welcomed a team from PNC Private Bank that managed over $1.5 billion in client assets, operating as KKM Wealth Partners within Alex. Brown.
items.quote: The team, based in Washington, D.C., arrives from PNC Private Bank, where it managed over $1.5 billion in client assets.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates employee advisor channel

items.text: Two Virginia wealth managers moved to Raymond James & Associates from Truist Investment Services, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Two veteran Virginia wealth managers have moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the firm's employee advisor channel.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates employee advisor channel

items.text: Raymond James Financial Services welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network adding approximately $500 million in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial Services (RJFS) welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel , adding approximately $500 million in client assets to its roster.
items.scope: Raymond James Financial Services independent advisor channel

items.text: A team operating as Le Sage Mattiza Maggard Wealth Management of Raymond James previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.
items.quote: Operating as Le Sage Mattiza Maggard Wealth Management of Raymond James in The Woodlands, Texas, the team previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.

items.text: Independent advisor Jeffrey Stillwell affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services; he managed approximately $240 million in client assets at Ameriprise Financial Services.
items.quote: In New Jersey, independent financial advisor Jeffrey Stillwell, CLU, has affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services , the independent channel of Raymond James Financial. He managed approximately $240 million in client assets at his old firm, Ameriprise Financial Services.

items.text: The Richmond recruits followed a $700 million advisor team that joined Raymond James & Associates in Beachwood, Ohio.
items.quote: The latest recruits follow a $700 million advisor team who joined RJA in Beachwood, Ohio , as reported by InvestmentNews earlier this week.
